limitations: Fuel is an explicit execution budget. None/ExecutionFailure must fail every differential test on valid operations; success-conditional proofs alone do not establish total correctness.
Fuel exhaustion, malformed internal states, and missing internal required entries share None internally; public invalid/missing API errors have distinct update_status constructors.
List order selects one ordering of Python set iterations. Observable contents and queries are sets; exact shape equality across runtimes is not claimed.
Node.from_intervals/from_sorted_intervals bulk construction is not translated. Tests start from empty_state and use actual incremental insertion paths.
Python exceptions, allocation failure, arbitrary endpoint classes, user-defined hashing/equality, mutable payloads, object aliasing and runtime resource costs are outside this model.
SortedDict behavior is modeled by boundary counters and sorted keys, not verified down to its concrete implementation.
No checked Python-to-Isabelle refinement theorem is provided; differential examples supply validation evidence only.
